discovery: Thick webbing chokes the trail ahead. Something is thrashing, cocooned high between the trees.

choices.label: Investigate
choices.description: Walk in and see what's happening

choices.label: Sneak Around
choices.description: Stealth check to glimpse it unseen

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - just keep walking

sneak_success: You pick your way around the webbing without disturbing a single strand, the spiders none the wiser.
sneak_fail: A strand snaps under your foot. Every spider on the web turns toward the vibration - toward you.
ignore: You give the webbing a wide berth and keep walking. Whatever's cocooned up there stops thrashing before long.

victim_data.dialogue: Careful - don't cut me loose right under the nest...
thanks: I couldn't move a muscle in that webbing. I owe you my life.
after: I'll be picking silk out of my hair for a week. Thank you, truly.

aftermath.discovery: The spiders are dead. The traveler is free of the webbing but still shaking silk from their sleeves.

choices.label: Escort Them to Town
choices.description: Walk them back to Northfield to recover
choices.outcome: You walk them clear of the webs and back to Northfield. The innkeeper sits them by the fire and presses a little coin into your hand for the trouble.

choices.label: Point Them Toward Home
choices.description: They say they can manage from here
choices.outcome: Still a little unsteady, they thank you again and set off down the trail alone.

choices.label: Leave Them Be
choices.description: ESC also cancels - they're free, that's enough
choices.outcome: You leave them picking silk from their clothes and continue on your way.
